title: 宇宙回环

selectedMaster.selection: First-pass visual review: one frontal eight-spoke wheel, four fixed seasonal medallions in required order, distinct cosmic observatory and complete arched X causeway; executor selection only.

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE new original 1024x1536 vertical opaque master illustration for an interactive Wheel of Fortune tarot card, theme 宇宙回环 (Cosmic Recurrence). The input is an identity/iconography reference only. Make this theme visibly different from sea, greenhouse and ice/fire scenes: deep indigo-violet cosmic observatory with a luminous astronomical instrument occupying the upper-middle, distant galaxies and orbital tracks behind it, and a complete tangible X-shaped causeway crossing the lower third among quiet celestial platforms. Main instrument is ONE precisely front-facing perfectly circular eight-spoke wheel, exactly EIGHT broad spokes, etched silver-gold metal with restrained blue-white starlight; do not put a second wheel behind it. Four SEPARATE season medallions fixed at the four corners around the wheel: flowers upper-left, simple sun upper-right, autumn leaves lower-left, snowy pine forest lower-right. They do not rotate or become portraits. Keep medallions and wheel fully inside canvas with safe margin. Elegant painterly fantasy art, refined celestial engraving and deep atmospheric space, indigo purple, silver gold, blue-white; no baked rainbow foil. No human, animal, text, numbers, title, watermark, border, duplicate emblems or broken floating path pieces. One full-canvas vertical master PNG.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected master after first-pass visual review; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 主轮八辐和四季圆章固定；额外无肖像细内环才可缓转；本主题支撑归属：主轮四章悬浮一组，远轨和实体路留背景. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target; opaque background plate.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
